project: Namias Portfolio - React Doctor 100/100 Fix Plan
summary: Comprehensive plan to achieve react-doctor 100/100 score. Currently at 60/100 with 11 issues (1 error, 10 warnings). Fixes organized into 11 commit slices covering data fetching refactoring, accessibility improvements, code splitting, and security hardening.

issues.description: fetch() inside useEffect can race, double-fire, or leak. Use a data-fetching layer or Server Component instead.
issues.fix: Refactor to use SWR hook for data fetching. SWR handles caching, deduplication, and cleanup automatically.

issues.description: Time or random value in JSX causes hydration mismatch. Move into useEffect+useState.
issues.fix: Already fixed with useState+useEffect. The warning may be from the fallback value. Add suppressHydrationWarning to the parent.

issues.description: Keyboard users can't focus this 'tablist' because it can't receive focus.
issues.fix: Add tabIndex={0} to the tablist div.

issues.description: Screen reader users get more reliable semantics from <output> than role='status'.
Screen reader users get more reliable semantics from <button> than role='button'.
CardBody component should be in its own file.
CardItem component should be in its own file.
JSON.stringify is embedded in HTML/script markup without HTML-escaping.
issues.fix: Use devalue library for HTML-safe serialization, or escape special characters.

issues.description: Build pipeline runs code near secrets.
issues.fix: Separate install step from deploy step. Run npm ci without secrets, then deploy with secrets.

issues.description: Build pipeline runs code near secrets.
issues.fix: Move secrets to step-level env vars instead of workflow-level.

issues.description: Build pipeline runs code near secrets.
issues.fix: Separate npm ci from npm run build. Only pass secrets to build step.

commitPlan.strategy: One commit per fix slice. Each commit passes tsc, lint, and vitest.
